Discord has no official way for a phone app to set your status, so Stash signs in as you and uses your account's own session. Discord's rules call that a self-bot and allow them to action the account.

Enforcement goes after spam rather than status updates, so this is unlikely — but it is your account, so it is your call.

Disconnecting clears your status and deletes the token from this phone.
Paste your Discord account token (from DevTools → Application → Local Storage → discord.com → \"token\").
Log into Spotify in a real browser and paste your sp_dc cookie. This works even when in-app sign-in is blocked by Spotify\'s bot check.
How to get your sp_dc cookie:

Easiest on a computer:
1. Open open.spotify.com and log in
2. Press F12 → Application → Cookies
3. Copy the value of 'sp_dc'

On a phone: use a browser that can show cookies (e.g. Firefox add-ons, or a cookie-viewer app).
Paste your YouTube Music cookies to connect.

1. Open a Private/Incognito window
2. Go to music.youtube.com and log in
3. Press F12 to open DevTools
4. Go to Network tab, click any request
5. Find 'Cookie' in Request Headers
6. Copy the ENTIRE cookie value

Must contain: SAPISID, LOGIN_INFO, SID

If your DAC has no volume control of its own, the phone\'s volume keys may stop working and music can play at full level.\n\nTurn the volume down before you press play.
